note: Decision scope (D231, D233, and D231 rounding correction; replaces D209 row in main catalogue, moving D209 to sensitivity D140). Written on 2026-11-15 by an AI session to follow D231 and D233 of issue #77 (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893254289), taken by the orchestrating AI session under the delegation of D161. Following executive sign-off, that row moves to the sensitivity catalogue of D140. Load one stage set for wheat only. WHAT IS LOCAL: the length to split, heading to physiological maturity at La Estanzuela, sowing period 1, intermediate cycle, 16 campaigns 2010-2025: 43.8 days (column AL; unrounded 43.78; campaign means 39.1-53.4), rounded to 44 at the nearest whole day, as the correction to D231 rounds every stage length (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893360747). WHAT IS TRANSFERRED: the split 70:30 between the mid and late stages, the proportion of FAO-56 Table 11, row «Winter Wheat | December | Calif., USA», mid 70 and late 30 days (chapter 6, https://www.fao.org/4/X0490E/x0490e0b.htm). WHAT IS CHOSEN: placing the start of the mid stage at heading (D231) and splitting the post-heading days by that row. The start of senescence (the FAO-56 end of the mid stage) is not measured locally; this is the least supported part of the stage set. ARITHMETIC: 44 x 70/100 = 30.8, rounded to 31; the late stage takes 44 x 30/100 = 13.2, rounded to 13; 31 + 13 = 44. Other splits, for context only: 50:50 gives 22/22, 80:20 gives 35/9. D233: rows by trial code containing «LE1»; the 109 rows of the 2014 trials at Young labelled La Estanzuela (Excel rows 2112-2220) are excluded. EP3 requires whole days (engine/water/stages.py).
